scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/eslint -w packages/error -w packages/kysely-db -w packages/kysely-db-sqlite -w packages/kysely-db-pg -w packages/kysely-db-pglite -w packages/crud -w packages/framestack -w packages/create-framestack-app
scripts.test: npm run build && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/*.test.ts packages/*/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.prepack:packages: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('.release', { recursive: true, force: true }); mkdirSync('.release')"
scripts.pack:packages: npm pack --workspace packages/create-framestack-app --workspace packages/crud --workspace packages/error --workspace packages/eslint --workspace packages/framestack --workspace packages/kysely-db --workspace packages/kysely-db-pg --workspace packages/kysely-db-pglite --workspace packages/kysely-db-sqlite --ignore-scripts --pack-destination .release
